svg.text: From road geometry to graph nodes

Every point is a real link midpoint from pos[:, 2]: 5,200 sampled links below, every second one of them redrawn above so the edges stay legible. 122 of 31,635 links fall outside the 1-99 percentile frame and sit on its edge.
31,635 links, WGS84 midpoints. Colour = OSM class.
each link becomes a node; an edge means two links meet
The inversion is the whole point: in the road network a junction is a node, here a road link is a node. That is why the model predicts
one value per link, and why 59,851 edges connect 31,635 nodes with a maximum degree of 10.
Generated from the published corpus by scripts/figure_generation/generate_isometric_diagrams.py.
